items.known: CKV_AWS_17 Ensure all data stored in RDS is not publicly accessible (resource aws_db_instance.default)
items.remediation: Set `publicly_accessible = false` to restrict access to within the VPC.

items.known: CKV_AWS_16 Ensure all data stored in the RDS is securely encrypted at rest (resource aws_db_instance.default)
items.remediation: Set `storage_encrypted = true` to enable encryption of the database storage.

items.known: CKV_AWS_382 Ensure no security groups allow egress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port -1 (resource aws_security_group_rule.egress)
items.remediation: Restrict the egress rule to specific destinations and ports, e.g., `cidr_blocks = ["10.0.0.0/16"]`.

items.known: CKV_AWS_355 Ensure no IAM policies documents allow "*" as a statement's resource for restrictable actions (resource aws_iam_role_policy.ec2policy)
items.remediation: Restrict the policy to necessary actions and resources, e.g., remove `s3:*`, `ec2:*`, and `rds:*` and specify required actions and resources.

scores.reason: Setting publicly_accessible = false is the standard fix for CKV_AWS_17.
Setting storage_encrypted = true is the standard fix for CKV_AWS_16. A kms_key_id is optional.

Right direction: restrict the egress cidr_blocks and ports. The example 10.0.0.0/16 is plausible, but the reviewer leaves protocol/from_port/to_port at -1/0, which would still trip the port -1 check. It is incomplete.

Right direction: replace the wildcard actions and Resource "*" with scoped ones. It does not name the Resource attribute or give specific ARNs, so it is vague. Removing actions alone does not fix the "*" resource.
